audit_notice: These are the v2.0.0 figures as printed by the repository evaluator. A November 2026 self-audit (AUDIT_2026-11.md) rates them Not Demonstrated as performance measures; the 'conclusions' below are superseded by that audit. Hop distances for p31, p654 (WLS), p810 and p866 are missing from this file.

conclusions.detection_improvement: CUSUM sequential detection (drift=0.5) significantly improved leak detection recall and precision by accumulating persistent small deviations from RF prediction baseline, tripling F1-score from 0.095 to 0.28.
conclusions.localization_improvement: L1-regularized sparse localization (Lasso with alpha=1e-4) dramatically improves accuracy in hydraulically observable areas (p183 hop distance drops from 57 to 2), though the localization problem remains challenging overall (median ~14 hops) due to sparse sensor coverage (33 sensors vs 782 junctions).
